question: Should OpenClaw adopt this public `compat.disableBoundaryAwareCache` contract with a DeepSeek automatic default, or require a config-free provider policy instead?
rationale: Both approaches can address the regression, but choosing whether this compatibility key becomes a durable public model/config surface is a product and upgrade-policy decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Sponsor this compat contract
